confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Spanish and Andalusian pricing, not from inspected live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand and heat can shift rates. Cocktail and wine are bounded from typical Spanish bar prices relative to beer. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not read that RBA table directly, so it should be verified before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Andalusian tourist city, priced below Seville and Granada and well below Madrid and Barcelona. Benchmarked against typical regional Spanish restaurant, bar, and budget-hotel pricing.
